facts.value: earlier of the next regular payday or 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded)
facts.summary: Idaho: when an employee is fired or laid off, final wages are due earlier of the next regular payday or 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded).
facts.evidence_quote: (1) Upon layoff, or upon termination of employment by either the employer or employee, the employer shall pay or make available at the usual place of payment all wages then due the employee by the earlier of the next regularly scheduled payday or within ten (10) days of such layoff or termination, weekends and holidays excluded.
facts.notes: If the employee makes a written request, wages are due within 48 hours of the request, weekends and holidays excluded (same section).

facts.value: earlier of the next regular payday or 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded)
facts.summary: Idaho: when an employee is quits or resigns, final wages are due earlier of the next regular payday or 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded).
facts.evidence_quote: (1) Upon layoff, or upon termination of employment by either the employer or employee, the employer shall pay or make available at the usual place of payment all wages then due the employee by the earlier of the next regularly scheduled payday or within ten (10) days of such layoff or termination, weekends and holidays excluded.
